Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to properly analyze and resolve the discrepancy in the address information provided by the Visit SLO page, which listed Paso Robles instead of San Luis Obispo. Although the Planner had flagged this inconsistency and instructed WebSurfer to resolve it by prioritizing map data and authoritative sources, WebSurfer repeatedly accessed the same Wikipedia page without addressing the conflicting data. This failure to verify and reconcile the conflicting address information could lead to an incorrect or incomplete solution to the task.
